title: Our Services
headline: For your project — from equipment selection to a working system
intro: Whether you’re building a new system, upgrading existing equipment or equipping an electrical panel, KASAMAN can help organise the work around your site and equipment requirements.
electrical_installation_text: We carry out electrical installation work for homes and industrial facilities. We plan connections and component installation with the system’s use and future maintenance in mind.
industrial_automation_text: We automate the control of equipment and motors. We tailor the solution to the operating process: what needs to start, when it should start and how it should be controlled.
panel_assembly_text: We assemble distribution and control panels to meet project requirements. We focus on component layout, orderly wiring and access for maintenance.
equipment_supply_text: We help select the equipment needed for electrical protection, control and power supply. The HIMEL range is also available in our online store.
technical_advice_text: Together, we clarify your needs, equipment requirements and component compatibility. We explain the available options so you understand what you’re choosing and why.
maintenance_upgrades_title: Maintenance and Upgrades for Existing Systems
maintenance_upgrades_text: We assess how your existing system operates and recommend maintenance or modifications based on its condition and your changing requirements.
cta: Send us your project or describe the issue, and we’ll discuss the work involved and the next steps.
